title: Hello everyone first post to just say hey : D

posts.author: TheSyntheticForest
posts.body:
Hello there everyone!
Wanted to create an intro post to just say hey and introduce myself to everyone, I am at heart an RPG lover as of late and I wanted to share how excited I am about getting into game development using this engine. So basically I am in a position where I am a creative individual that knows I can handle doing this. My biggest strength by far is audio so music and sfx will be a breeze as that will be content I can basically create in my sleep at this point. I am new to pixel art graphic design but having a blast learning new things everyday! I tried using godot but I can't code to save my life LOL.
I am overjoyed that doing things like adding in 8 directional movement and additions to extend RPG Maker MZ can be done via js plugins which has made me switch over to using MZ its a no brainer and I am about to embark into a very special and personal project of mine!
I am so grateful for all of the third js scripts its going to make things much much more manageable for me to control : ).
Anyways this is just a quick intro post!
Very happy to be here <3

Hello!
And oh no! Don't give up on Godot
JOIN THE GODOT CULT!!!
All joking aside, using RPG Maker as your first engine is a great idea to start learning game development. There is a lot, and I mean a lot, to this outside of coding. My tip would be to focus on creating small, simple games. You don't have to create your dream game right away. If you really want to work on your dream game from the start, then limit the scope, focus on the basics, and don't worry about making it look amazing or play perfectly. Focus on completing it, and then you can decide if you should invest more time in it.
